description: ECMWF IFS 2025-10-28 00Z analysis, 50-20S 140E-180, all six fields. BoM analysed a cold front and a trough in the Tasman Sea.

expected.caveat: An automatic analysis from 850 hPa temperature and wind (thermal front parameter) and from pressure, not a forecaster's chart. Occluded fronts are shown as cold or warm.
